idea-plugin.name: Graphite Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A neutral dark theme with the colours of the Dark theme of Visual Studio 2026, decoded from Visual Studio's own theme data: grey chrome, Visual Studio's purple accent and its dark C# colours.

Every text colour is checked for contrast when the theme is built. Requires JetBrains IDEs 2026.2 or later with the Islands UI.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or JetBrains. Visual Studio is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation; Rider is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.

Shared semantic colours for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python, with this theme's own palette and clearly separated panels.
